# What do RevenueDot webhook events mean?

Each page below answers one webhook event in a sentence, then gives when it is sent, what your server should do, a handler you can run and the rule in RevenueDot's code that produces it (21 pages). Every field of every event, with a recorded payload, is in [which webhook events RevenueDot sends](../../api/webhook-events.md).

## The 21 event types

RevenueCat's webhook event types, the same names and fields on RevenueDot. Two are accepted in a filter but never sent.
